ENGINES.label: Google
ENGINES.notes: Broad operator support; some operators (e.g. cache:) may be limited or unavailable over time.

ENGINES.label: Bing
ENGINES.notes: Supports many core operators; behavior/coverage differs from Google.

ENGINES.label: DuckDuckGo
ENGINES.notes: Privacy-focused; operator support differs and some advanced operators may be ignored.

QUERIES.label: All indexed pages
QUERIES.template: site:{target}
QUERIES.description: Find pages indexed for the target scope.
QUERIES.explanation: Uses site: to scope results to the target domain/host.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Supported broadly; subdomain scoping differs by engine.

QUERIES.label: Subdomain references
QUERIES.template: site:*.{target} -www
QUERIES.description: Discover indexed subdomains related to the target.
QUERIES.explanation: site: with wildcard and exclusion of common www host to surface other subdomains.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Wildcard/subdomain behavior varies by engine.

QUERIES.label: Related hostnames in text
QUERIES.template: "{target}" -site:{target}
QUERIES.description: Mentions of the target outside its own indexed pages.
QUERIES.explanation: Searches for the target string while excluding on-site results.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Core operators; behavior may vary by engine.

QUERIES.label: Public code mentions
QUERIES.template: "{target}" (site:github.com OR site:gitlab.com OR site:bitbucket.org)
QUERIES.description: Public code hosting references to the target.
QUERIES.explanation: Looks for target mentions on common code platforms.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Core operators; behavior may vary by engine.

QUERIES.label: Public paste mentions
QUERIES.template: "{target}" (site:pastebin.com OR site:pastetext.net OR site:hastebin.com OR site:gist.github.com)
QUERIES.explanation: Searches paste-style sites for target mentions.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Core operators; behavior may vary by engine.

QUERIES.label: Cached page (Google)
QUERIES.template: cache:{target}
QUERIES.description: Attempt to view a cached copy (engine-dependent).
QUERIES.enginesNote: Google-specific; may be limited/unavailable.

QUERIES.label: Historical/indexed date hints
QUERIES.template: site:{target} (inurl:2023 OR inurl:2024 OR inurl:2025)
QUERIES.description: Find URLs containing year patterns that may hint at older content.
QUERIES.explanation: Searches for year-like path segments within the target.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Heuristic; not a true archive search.

QUERIES.label: PDF documents
QUERIES.template: site:{target} filetype:pdf
QUERIES.explanation: Scopes to target and filters by PDF extension.
QUERIES.enginesNote: Core operators; behavior may vary by engine.

QUERIES.label: Office documents

PLAYBOOKS.name: Full Domain Recon

PLAYBOOKS.name: Web Application Recon
PLAYBOOKS.description: Application-focused reconnaissance for login, admin, APIs, and parameter surfaces.
PLAYBOOKS.coverage: Authentication/admin portals, API and docs, parameterized endpoints, and common indexed directories.

PLAYBOOKS.name: Infrastructure Recon
PLAYBOOKS.coverage: Domain footprint, subdomain/hostname references, dev/staging/test hosts and paths, and tech surfaces.

PLAYBOOKS.name: Sensitive File Exposure Review
PLAYBOOKS.description: Publicly indexed indicators of sensitive files and artifacts.
PLAYBOOKS.coverage: Documents, configuration and key-material indicators, backups, archives, logs, and database dump references (indicators only).

PLAYBOOKS.name: API Recon
PLAYBOOKS.description: API endpoints, documentation, and development surfaces.
PLAYBOOKS.coverage: REST/GraphQL paths, Swagger/OpenAPI docs, dev/staging references, and parameterized API-like URLs.

PLAYBOOKS.name: Bug Bounty Intelligence
PLAYBOOKS.description: Target disclosure info plus global program discovery.
PLAYBOOKS.coverage: Target security.txt/policies/contacts and global responsible disclosure & bug bounty discovery queries.
